These sessions are designed to support all areas of baby development, with a strong focus on parent and baby bonding. Activities encourage fine and gross motor skills, body awareness, early language development, rhythm, and social interaction. Building on the gentle foundations of Caterpillar Club, Busy Bees introduces instruments, movement, and our amazing branded props to support development in all areas through play and music. ✨ Different Theme Every Week! ✨ Our classes feature a brand new theme every week for a whole year! During theme time, babies can enjoy themed music, dress-up, sensory lights, fun props, and heuristic treasure baskets. Busy Bees love interacting with each other while exploring the themed activities, while our Caterpillar babies can enjoy tummy time alongside sensory lights and themed props. Theme time is also a lovely opportunity for parents to relax, chat, and build friendships within our Bloom community.

description: LAOLA Movement was founded in 2023 by Taty, a German born, Ireland based certified Pilates instructor with a love for movement, connection, and the outdoors. Her mission? To help people feel stronger, more flexible, and ultimately happier in their own skin — through joyful, accessible Pilates classes and unforgettable experiences in nature. LAOLA’s name is inspired by the German word for “Mexican wave” (La Ola) — a symbol of community, rhythm, and spine mobility (the core of Pilates!). It perfectly reflects the brand’s philosophy: to move together, to celebrate our bodies, and to ride life’s waves — on the mat and beyond. What began as a handful of outdoor classes quickly grew into a growing movement in the local community. Today, LAOLA offers a mix of outdoor group classes in summer , online sessions in winter , and one-of-a-kind Pilates events that bring like-minded souls together — from sea swims to paddleboarding and even Pilates with alpacas. Taty is YMCA accredited through Reformation Studio (Dublin), with additional qualifications in Ante & Postnatal Pilates (APPI, London 2024) and an ongoing focus on women’s health and the transitions women go through across life stages. Every class is led by her personally, blending technical precision with fun, human connection. Whether you're a curious beginner or a seasoned mover, LAOLA Movement welcomes all genders and levels . Taty creates a space that’s equal parts grounding and uplifting—rooted in movement, laughter, and community care. Outdoor events include: Outdoor Pilates & Sea Swims (every Monday 7pm!) This experience is an invitation to pause, soften, and reconnect with your inner stillness. Whether you are seeking clarity, grounding, or simple relaxation, this session offers a sacred space to realign and recharge.
